title: What Scripture Actually Means by "Put It to Death"
caption:
Romans 8 doesn't say try harder. It says by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, and that word was never a suggestion to manage anything.

A sin you're managing is a sin you're still feeding, just on a schedule you feel okay about. Death doesn't negotiate a schedule. What stays hidden survives, so confession is where the killing actually starts. Say it to one brother and it's already losing.

It doesn't die in one dramatic moment either. It dies the same way it grew: the same no, said again tomorrow, until it finally stops asking.
